illustrative_job.rule: illustration criterion v2 (D-054): over the same eligible set, sort by (declared GPU-h, job_uid) and take the first job whose cumulative declared GPU-h reaches 50% of the set's total (the GPU-hour-weighted median)
illustrative_job.disclosure: The literal count-median job is a 2-GPU, 99 s SFT job (5952732#c4; the set's median is 0.055 GPU-h) because short jobs dominate the trace. We show the job at the GPU-hour-weighted median, which represents where the set's energy sits. The criterion was chosen after seeing that the count-median job is 2 minutes long, before seeing any outcome for the new pick.
